meta.title: Awesome-TCM-LLM
meta.description_zh: 开源中文医疗大模型（中医/西医）相关新闻、论文、模型与数据集精选列表。
meta.description_en: Curated open resources for Traditional Chinese Medicine (and related Chinese medical) LLMs.

items.name: 上海市第七人民医院发布岐元中医大模型，支持名老中医Agent数字孪生
items.summary_zh: 上海中医药大学附属第七人民医院正式发布**岐元大模型**，采用预训练+领域微调+专家强化学习，支持生成式病历与名老中医Agent数字孪生，并亮相WAIC
items.summary_en: Shanghai Seventh People's Hospital (SHUTCM) releases the **Qiyuan** TCM LLM with pretraining, domain fine-tuning, and expert RL; supports generative medical records and master-physician Agent digital twins; showcased at WAIC.

items.name: 贵州医大等发布华族本草民族药AI大模型
items.summary_zh: 贵州医科大学等在中国—东盟教育交流周发布全国首个民族药创制全域智能平台**华族本草**，以数智岐黄+Qwen为底座融汇多民族医药古籍
items.summary_en: Guizhou Medical University and partners launch **HuaZu BenCao**, a national ethnic-medicine AI platform built on ShuZhi QiHuang + Qwen integrating multi-ethnic materia medica classics.

items.name: 安顿七诊合参中医机器人与天回大模型亮相WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 安顿健康在WAIC 2026首发**七诊合参**中医机器人，集成面/红外面/舌/耳/闻/问/脉采集，底座含天回脉诊算法与中医诊疗大模型
items.summary_en: Andun Health debuts a **seven-diagnosis** TCM robot at WAIC 2026, integrating face/IR face/tongue/ear/auscultation/inquiry/pulse sensing with TianHui pulse algorithms and a TCM clinical LLM.

items.name: 智慧眼砭石多模态中医大模型亮相WAIC 2026
items.summary_zh: 智慧眼携**砭石云中医**亮相WAIC 2026，以已备案砭石多模态大模型为底座，展示四诊仪与辅助诊疗系统
items.summary_en: Insightful Eye presents **Bianshi Cloud TCM** at WAIC 2026, built on a registered Bianshi multimodal model with four-diagnosis devices and assisted-care systems.

items.name: 中科闻歌通过港交所上市聆讯；报道提及与中国中医科学院合作的大医金匮中医大模型已通
items.summary_zh: 中科闻歌通过港交所上市聆讯；报道提及与中国中医科学院合作的**大医金匮**中医大模型已通过中国信通院最高级别可信AI认证
items.align_note: 大医金匮聆讯措辞已按核验修正
items.summary_en: Zhongke Wenge passes HKEX listing hearing; reports note the **DaYi JinKui** TCM LLM (with CACMS) has obtained top-tier CAICT Trusted AI certification.

items.name: 北京中医药大学牵头研发的薪火中国药中医药教育大模型通过国家生成式人工智能服务备案
items.summary_zh: 北京中医药大学牵头研发的**薪火中国药**中医药教育大模型通过国家生成式人工智能服务备案，成为国内首个获批面向公众服务的中医药领域大模型
items.summary_en: Beijing University of Chinese Medicine's **XinHuo ZhongGuoYao** TCM education LLM completes national generative-AI service filing—the first publicly approved TCM-domain model of its kind.

items.name: 山东启动智汇岐黄中医药大模型重点场景项目
items.summary_zh: 山东中医药大学附属医院启动山东省卫健委「人工智能＋」中医药重点场景**智汇岐黄**大模型项目
items.summary_en: Affiliated Hospital of Shandong University of TCM launches the provincial AI+ TCM scenario project **ZhiHui QiHuang**.

items.name: 八部门印发中药工业高质量发展实施方案提出AI与知识图谱赋能
items.summary_zh: 工信部等八部门印发《中药工业高质量发展实施方案（2026—2030年）》，明确运用人工智能与知识图谱赋能经典名方与名老中医经验方研发
items.summary_en: Eight ministries issue the TCM Industry High-Quality Development Plan (2026–2030), calling for AI and knowledge graphs to empower classical formulas and master physicians' prescriptions.

items.name: 吉林发布众星·长白岐黄1.0 AI原生多模态中医药大模型
items.summary_zh: 吉林发布**众星·长白岐黄1.0** AI原生多模态中医药大模型
items.summary_en: Jilin releases **ZhongXing·Changbai Qihuang 1.0**, an AI-native multimodal TCM LLM.

items.name: 固生堂发布”中医大脑”产品及国医大师施杞教授AI数字分身，已累计发布14位顶级专
items.summary_zh: 固生堂发布”中医大脑”产品及国医大师施杞教授AI数字分身，已累计发布14位顶级专家数字分身，覆盖八大中医核心专科
items.summary_en: Gushengtang launches a “TCM Brain” product and AI digital twin of National TCM Master Shi Qi; 14 expert twins cover eight core specialties.

items.name: 智明堂ZMT-M1在国家中医执业医师资格考试模拟测试中以96.26分获得该领域最
items.summary_zh: **智明堂ZMT-M1**在国家中医执业医师资格考试模拟测试中以96.26分获得该领域最佳成绩，已在全国100余间诊室试点应用
items.summary_en: **ZMT-M1** scores 96.26 on a simulated national TCM practitioner exam and is piloted in 100+ clinics.

items.name: 国家卫健委等五部门印发《关于促进和规范”人工智能+医疗卫生”应用发展的实施意见》
items.summary_zh: 国家卫健委等五部门印发《关于促进和规范”人工智能+医疗卫生”应用发展的实施意见》，明确支撑建设中医药诊疗大模型
items.summary_en: Five national health ministries issue AI+ healthcare guidelines that explicitly support building TCM diagnostic LLMs.

items.name: 传神语联任度·素问通过中国信通院可信AI中医药大模型4+级评估
items.summary_zh: 传神语联**任度·素问**通过中国信通院可信AI中医药大模型4+级评估
items.summary_en: Transn's **RenDu·SuWen** passes CAICT Trusted AI TCM LLM Level 4+ evaluation.

items.name: 智赋岐黄天功中医AI大模型通过国家深度合成服务算法备案，应用于中医四诊仪与体质辨
items.summary_zh: **智赋岐黄天功**中医AI大模型通过国家深度合成服务算法备案，应用于中医四诊仪与体质辨识
items.summary_en: **ZhiFu Qihuang Tiangong** TCM AI model completes national deep-synthesis algorithm filing for four-diagnosis devices and constitution assessment.

items.name: 伊尹中医经典大模型在河南嵩县启用
items.summary_zh: 中原药谷基层中医药振兴工程下，**伊尹中医经典大模型**在嵩县发布启用，融合中医教育与AI辅助诊疗服务县域基层
items.summary_en: **YiYin** classical TCM LLM goes live in Song County, Henan, combining TCM education with AI-assisted care for county clinics.

items.name: 固生堂正式发布十大”国医AI分身”，基于国医大师及名中医临床经验构建，辨证准确性
items.summary_zh: **固生堂**正式发布十大”国医AI分身”，基于国医大师及名中医临床经验构建，辨证准确性达86%以上
items.summary_en: **Gushengtang** releases ten “National Master AI twins” trained on master clinicians' experience, reporting >86% pattern-differentiation accuracy.

items.name: 天河·灵枢中医药大模型2.0与智能模型评价体系发布
items.summary_zh: 国家超算天津中心联合天津中医药大学等发布**天河·灵枢**2.0，由针灸专科扩展至20余科；同步启动中医药智能模型评价体系
items.summary_en: NSCC-TJ and Tianjin University of TCM release **TianHe·LingShu** 2.0 (expanded beyond acupuncture to 20+ specialties) and launch a TCM intelligent-model evaluation system.

items.name: 广安门医院成立广医·岐智大模型智能体联盟
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院与多家医联体单位成立**广医·岐智大模型智能体联盟**，推进跨机构智能诊疗能力辐射
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital forms the **GuangYi·QiZhi** LLM agent alliance with medical consortium partners for cross-institution intelligent care.

items.name: 中医横琴垂类大模型正式发布
items.summary_zh: **中医横琴**垂类大模型正式发布
items.summary_en: **TCM Hengqin** vertical LLM is officially released.

items.name: 中国中医科学院发布中医药大模型评测标准
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院发布中医药大模型评测标准
items.summary_en: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences releases evaluation standards for TCM large models.

items.name: 传神语联发布任度·素问中医大模型，基于全自研混合熵(moH)技术架构，支持智能问
items.summary_zh: 传神语联发布**任度·素问**中医大模型，基于全自研混合熵(moH)技术架构，支持智能问诊、辨证分析、方剂推荐
items.summary_en: Transn releases **RenDu·SuWen** TCM LLM (mixture-of-entropy architecture) for inquiry, pattern differentiation, and formula recommendation.

items.name: 中国中医科学院广安门医院28日正式发布广医·岐智中医大模型，成为国内首家本地化部
items.summary_zh: 中国中医科学院广安门医院28日正式发布**广医·岐智**中医大模型，成为国内首家本地化部署”算力+模型+应用”一体化服务的中医医院
items.summary_en: Guang'anmen Hospital releases **GuangYi·QiZhi**, described as the first TCM hospital with integrated local compute + model + application deployment.

items.name: 招联联合中山大学与广中医深圳医院发布仲思中医大模型
items.summary_zh: 招联消费金融联合中山大学、广州中医药大学深圳医院发布中医垂直大模型**仲思**，落地深圳多家社康中心智能问诊
items.summary_en: China UnionPay Consumer Finance with Sun Yat-sen University and GZUCMS Shenzhen Hospital release vertical TCM LLM **ZhongSi** for community clinic inquiry.

items.name: 中科闻歌发布大医金匮中医大模型及中医智能健康管理平台，基于1500余本中医典籍训
items.summary_zh: 中科闻歌发布**大医金匮**中医大模型及中医智能健康管理平台，基于1500余本中医典籍训练
items.summary_en: Zhongke Wenge releases **DaYi JinKui** TCM LLM and health platform trained on 1,500+ TCM classics.

items.name: 天士力与华为发布数智本草中医药语言与计算双模态大模型
items.summary_zh: 天士力与华为云联合发布**数智本草**大模型，基于盘古语言与药物分子模型，覆盖中药研发全链条；后通过信通院中医药大模型4+级评估
items.summary_en: Tasly and Huawei Cloud release **ShuZhi BenCao** (Pangu language + molecular models) covering TCM R&D; later earns CAICT TCM LLM Level 4+.

items.name: 华东师范大学、上海中医药大学、华东理工大学、海军军医大学、临港实验室、华润江中现
items.summary_zh: 华东师范大学、上海中医药大学、华东理工大学、海军军医大学、临港实验室、华润江中现代中药全国重点实验室联合开发了**数智岐黄**中医药大模型。
items.summary_en: ECNU, SHUTCM, ECUST, NMMU, Lingang Lab, and CR Jiangzhong jointly develop the **ShuZhi QiHuang** TCM LLM.

items.name: 大经中医发布岐黄问道中医大模型
items.summary_zh: 南京大经中医发布**岐黄问道·大模型**，基于千万级知识图谱与临床数据，面向医疗机构开放内测
items.summary_en: Nanjing Dajing TCM releases **QiHuang Wendao** LLM with large knowledge graphs and clinical data for institutional beta use.

items.name: CORE-Acu
items.summary_zh: 针灸临床决策：结构化推理轨迹与知识图谱安全否决闭环
items.summary_en: Acupuncture clinical decision support with structured reasoning traces and a knowledge-graph safety veto loop.

items.name: DERM-3R
items.summary_zh: 资源受限下的中医皮肤病多模态多智能体框架（识别/表征/辨证论治三智能体）
items.summary_en: Resource-constrained multimodal multi-agent framework for TCM dermatology (recognition / representation / SDT agents).

items.name: GastroTCM
items.summary_zh: 中医消化内科大模型，基于Llama3-8B微调并结合RAG与智能体框架
items.summary_en: TCM gastroenterology LLM fine-tuned from Llama3-8B with RAG and agent scaffolding.

items.name: MMIR-TCM
items.summary_zh: 记忆增强的多模态舌诊与临床决策框架，提出 MedTCM 数据集与 TDEU 评测指标
items.summary_en: Memory-augmented multimodal tongue diagnosis and clinical decision framework; proposes MedTCM dataset and TDEU metric.

items.name: Qwen-TCM-Dia
items.summary_zh: 面向中医泄泻的专科微调模型（续训+CoT指令微调），覆盖症状→病机→治法→方药推理链
items.summary_en: Specialty fine-tuned model for TCM diarrhea care (CPT + CoT SFT) covering symptom→pathomechanism→method→formula chains.

items.name: TCM-Agent
items.summary_zh: 面向网络药理学与中药发现的 LLM 多智能体系统
items.summary_en: LLM multi-agent system for network pharmacology and herbal discovery.

items.name: TCM-DiffRAG
items.summary_zh: 通用知识图谱 + 个性化知识图谱 + CoT 的辨证推理 RAG 框架
items.summary_en: Syndrome-differentiation RAG with a general KG, a personalized KG, and chain-of-thought.

items.name: TongueVLM
items.summary_zh: 中医舌诊多模态大模型，支持舌象描述生成与体质推理
items.summary_en: Multimodal VLM for TCM tongue diagnosis, description generation, and constitution reasoning.

items.name: 杏核 (Xinghe)
items.summary_zh: 基于Qwen3.5-9B、扎根《黄帝内经》的推理型中医模型，显式思维链辨证并强调安全边界
items.summary_en: Qwen3.5-9B reasoning TCM model grounded in the *Neijing*, with explicit CoT pattern differentiation and safety boundaries.

items.name: 灵兰秘典 (LingLan)
items.summary_zh: 大规模多任务中医评测基准，覆盖 5 大域、13 子任务、25624 实例
items.summary_en: Large multi-task TCM benchmark: 5 domains, 13 subtasks, 25,624 instances.

items.name: ATCMD-Bench
items.summary_zh: 首个Agentic中医诊断基准，通过多智能体模拟问诊评估LLM诊疗能力
items.summary_en: First agentic TCM diagnosis benchmark, evaluating LLMs through multi-agent simulated consultations.

items.name: 中医端到端临床支持基准
items.summary_zh: 面向端到端临床支持全链路的中医LLM评测基准
items.summary_en: Benchmark for end-to-end TCM clinical support across the full LLM care pipeline.

items.name: 青囊 (QingNangTCM)
items.summary_zh: 参数高效微调的中医问答与临床推理模型，构建10万条**QnTCM_Dataset**语料
items.summary_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuned TCM QA and clinical reasoning model; builds the 100k-item **QnTCM_Dataset**.

items.name: HerbWise
items.summary_zh: 面向传统草药（THM）的领域大模型，服务草药现代化与标准化
items.summary_en: Domain LLM for traditional herbal medicine (THM), serving herbal modernization and standardization.
orgs_en: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.name: Med-Shicheng（师承）
items.summary_zh: 基于天医 (Tianyi) 的轻量级名老中医经验传承框架，单模型内化5位国医大师知识系统、覆盖7类任务
items.summary_en: Lightweight master-physician experience-inheritance framework built on Tianyi; a single model internalizes 5 national masters' knowledge systems across 7 task types.
orgs_en: Nanjing University of Chinese Medicine et al.

items.name: DongYuan
items.summary_zh: 中西医结合脾胃病诊断LLM框架，融合中医辨证与西医诊断推理
items.summary_en: Integrative spleen–stomach disease diagnosis LLM framework combining TCM pattern differentiation with Western diagnostic reasoning.

items.name: MACAT
items.summary_zh: 多智能体文化感知翻译框架，实验覆盖中医经典与《论语》文化负载词英译
items.summary_en: Multi-agent culture-aware translation framework, evaluated on culture-loaded terms from TCM classics and the Analects.

items.name: TongueDx2
items.summary_zh: 舌诊深度学习设计空间系统消融研究（20+模型版本），含5109图像/976专家标注
items.summary_en: Systematic ablation of the tongue-diagnosis DL design space (20+ model variants); TongueDx2 includes 5,109 images / 976 expert annotations.

items.name: Med-Bench-Arena
items.summary_zh: 面向医学与中医药LLM/Agent的开源评测平台，支持HF/vLLM/LiteLLM、多模态与中医特色指标（ZhongJing团队）
items.summary_en: Open evaluation platform for medical and TCM LLMs/Agents (HF/vLLM/LiteLLM, multimodal, TCM-specific metrics), from the ZhongJing team.

items.name: TCMBenchEval
items.summary_zh: 基于真实临床医案的LLM中医评测基准
items.summary_en: Benchmark evaluating LLMs on real clinical TCM case records (ICIC 2026).

items.name: 舌面多模态融合智能诊断
items.summary_zh: 舌-面多模态特征融合+LLM驱动的中医智能诊断
items.summary_en: Tongue–face multimodal feature fusion with LLM-driven intelligent TCM diagnosis.

items.name: TCMI-F-6D
items.summary_zh: 中医信息学跨学科基础能力六维基准
items.summary_en: Six-dimensional benchmark of interdisciplinary foundational competence in TCM informatics.

items.name: 靳三针知识图谱问答 (Jin San Zhen KG-QA)
items.summary_zh: 靳三针针灸流派知识图谱+大模型问答工具
items.summary_en: Knowledge graph + LLM QA tool for the Jin San Zhen acupuncture school.

items.name: KDC-NER
items.summary_zh: 知识引导数据增强+大模型微调的中医嵌套命名实体识别框架
items.summary_en: Knowledge-guided data augmentation + LLM fine-tuning framework for nested NER in TCM.

items.name: CMM-EmbedCluster
items.summary_zh: 基于LLM与药性理论的中药聚类框架，构建567味药性知识库
items.summary_en: LLM + medicinal-property-theory clustering framework for Chinese materia medica, with a 567-herb property knowledge base.

orgs_en: Beijing Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine

items.summary_zh: 跨认知层级的多模态LLM中医教育评估
items.summary_en: Multimodal LLM evaluation for TCM education across cognitive levels.

items.summary_zh: 大规模与轻量级LLM中医考题系统对比
orgs: 河南大学第一附属医院

items.summary_en: Benchmarking multimodal LLMs for medicinal plant identification.
